top_signals.title: The world needs Ukraine’s grain. Its farmers are running out of reasons to plant
top_signals.summary: Cash-strapped farmers have no incentive to sow for 2027 with exports remaining trapped, as analysts say commodity markets could "flip fast."

top_signals.title: US Army activates new multi-domain task force to ‘deny, disrupt’ enemies in Indo-Pacific

top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Unpatched AhsayCBS flaws exploited to deploy webshells, mine crypto
top_signals.summary: Threat actors are exploiting one critical and one medium-severity vulnerability still unpatched in the AhsayCBS backup management platform to deploy webshells and cryptocurrency miners. [...]

top_signals.title: Takaichi again in a bind as U.S. threatens to ‘end’ ICC
top_signals.summary: Japan, which hosts roughly 60,000 U.S. service members and depends on Washington for its security, will need to walk a fine line as it pushes back.
